name: Qube Browser 0.7.2
notes:
0.7.2
Fixed:
* Qube no longer quits when Essentials move aside
* Sites such as bol.com no longer block Qube as a bot

0.7.1
Improved:
* The latest security updates for websites
* Steadier Netflix playback with Ambient Glow on

0.7.0
New:
* A Picture in Picture button on videos

Improved:
* Sites without an icon get a letter icon in their own colour

0.6.1
Improved:
* New look for the command bar, and it completes more of your sites

Fixed:
* The letter y can be typed in websites again

0.6.0
New:
* A version for Windows on Arm PCs
* Capture and Capture Full Page
* Developer Mode per site, with its own toolbar
* Site notifications on Essentials and tabs in the sidebar
* Never Unload for pinned tabs and Essentials
* Qube asks before the last window closes

Improved:
* Peek opens and closes more smoothly
* Links that Essentials and pinned tabs open in a new tab show as a Peek
* New look for the command bar and the page menu
* Folders and pinned tabs in any order, and folders can be dragged
* Find on Page: Return asks Qube Spark about the page
* Colours follow the Space throughout the sidebar
* A site's question stays until you answer it

Fixed:
* PDFs scroll smoothly
* Uploading files works again
* Sidebar icons stay sharp when the display scale changes
summary: Qube no longer quits when Essentials move aside, and bol.com works again.

mac.name: Qube for Mac 0.10.25
mac.notes:
Fixed:

* The New Tab row could disappear and leave an empty band
* Closed tabs left a gap instead of the rows below moving up
mac.summary: Fixes the sidebar losing its New Tab row.
